title: ICC Integrity
meta_description: The official ICC Integrity mobile application
full_description: The ICC Integrity App has been developed as a support tool for all cricket Participants (including, without limitation, players, team staff, match-officials, player agents, curators and ICC staff and officials) to protect the spirit and integrity of the game.The application provides:A secure and easy channel through which to report any suspicious incidents or behavior, whether related to corruption, doping, or other integrity concerns.Easy access to Anti-Doping and Anti-Corruption rules and regulations that you must abide by in order to protect your career.Other relevant awareness and educational material concerning Anti-Corruption and Anti-Doping.
